The spec's 边界 confines the change to the arbiter code face, so this is drift to fix in a follow-up, not a deliverable miss.

The dispatch prompt states product commit (`work_head_commit`) = efa473eae069c7a3b5c5681f6921e536b5a05b5f, but the committed implement handoff records `work_head_commit` = b3a2dd97adc7cb11d7142366b866441c6a41184a with efa473ea as the stacked metadata-only implementation_subject_commit. The handoff is self-consistent with the documented materialization mechanism; the prompt line appears to echo the subject commit instead.

The mandated product-consistency command `git diff --exit-code efa473ea 70598e6 -- . ':(exclude).dev-dispatch'` was not executed: this reviewer has only read-only file inspection and no shell. Consistency was instead assessed by inspecting the checked-out tree, where the only review-stage additions observed are inside the reserved `.dev-dispatch/` namespace (feedback/index.json and reviews/rc-…/review.json); no product-file divergence was found, but the exclusion diff itself remains mechanically unverified here.
